title: Director - Post-Silicon Validation (Functional)
description:
Graphcore

Director-Post Silicon Validation (Functional)

Graphcore is a globally recognised leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and data centre hardware that provide the specialised processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption.  

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. We are opening a new AI Engineering Campus in Austin, Texas which will play a central role in Graphcore's work building the future of AI computing.  

We are developing the next generation of AI compute, a large-scale system-on-chip (SoC) designed to power future high-performance AI systems. 

 

Job Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to be part of a collaborative, cross-functional development team validating cutting-edge, high-performance AI chips and platforms.

You will play a key role in supporting new product introductions and validation. You will lead a team delivering post-silicon validation across the full AI SoC, working across silicon, firmware, and platform levels. The role requires a deep technical understanding, strong hands-on debug experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively with hardware, software, and systems engineering teams.

Working within the Validation team, you will be involved with bringing first silicon to life, functionally validating it and working closely with many other teams to help it become a fully   characterised   and working product, reporting project status/progress to program management on a regular basis. You will have the opportunity to provide technical guidance to other engineering team members. In this role, you can leverage our experience and industry knowledge to architect and drive implementation of continuous improvements to test infrastructure and processes.

 

The Team

The Post-Silicon   Bringup   team sits within the Architecture and Validation team, we are responsible for   bringup   and validation of new silicon when it returns from manufacture, enabling and supporting the production SW and FW teams to bring up their software and supporting the Silicon Characterisation team.

 

Responsibilities and Duties:

•   Plan, design, develop and debug silicon validation tests in bare metal C/C++ on FPGA/Emulator prior to first silicon

•   Deploy silicon validation tests on first silicon and debugging them

•   Develop automated test framework and regression test suites in Python to optimize validation efficiency

•   Collaborate closely with engineers from many other disciplines on a variety of topics

•   Work with Validation and Production Test engineering peers to implement best practices and continuous improvements to test methodologies

•   Analyse test results, identify and debug failures/defects

•   Contribute to shared test and validation infrastructure

•   Provide feedback to architects  

 

Minimum Qualifications:

•   Understanding of ML applications and their workloads

•   A self-starter who can apply independent judgement

•   A team player able to lead and support colleagues with difficult concepts

•   Strong experience in Bare metal / embedded C/C++

•   Excellent problem-solving, analytical & diagnostic skills

•   Ability to work across teams and programming languages to find root causes of critical and complex issues

•   Experience of the post-silicon validation process applied in digital ASIC environments

•   Python, Linux

•   Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain difficult concepts to resolve issues 

 

Preferred Qualifications:

•   10+   years  experience  

•   Experience building and leading, multi-site team

title: Senior HW Engineer – Signal and Power Integrity
description: The Opportunity Every board Lumai builds has to run multi-gigabit links and feed high-current ASIC and FPGA rails. Getting those right before the board is fabricated is the difference between a working system and a respin cycle. This role owns the modelling, the stackups, the materials and the design rules that make it work, and has a direct say in the decisions that prevent the respin. The Role You will own signal and power integrity across our boards and packages. That means pre-layout channel studies that set routing topologies, stackups, materials and constraints; post-layout analysis of critical channels, including insertion and return loss, crosstalk, and eye and COM analysis with IBIS-AMI models; optimisation of vias, breakouts, connector launches and the transitions into our optical engines; and PDN impedance targets, decoupling strategies and DC drop analysis for high-current rails. What is genuinely hard is that the channels cross boundaries - chip, package, interposer, board and optical engine - and a model is only as good as its weakest corner. You will spend as much time at the bench as in the tool, correlating what you predicted against what the hardware does, and feeding that back into design rules. By month six, you will have signed off the critical channels on at least one board, built the model libraries and design guidelines the team reuses, and be the person whose analysis decides when a layout is ready to release. What You'll Do Run pre-layout channel studies to set routing topologies, stackups, materials and design constraints for high-speed interfaces. Carry out post-layout SI analysis

title: FinOps Analyst
description:
Embarrassed to call yourself an accountant? Don’t worry - you’re not alone.
Accounting is stuck in the past.
So, we get stuck doing boring, monotonous work as a small cog in tedious firms, or struggling to make an impact in businesses that don’t really care.
RORA was founded to improve the career options for Accountants. We promise impact, variety and progression. We’re looking for those who crave more - more responsibility and more impact - and want to keep progressing and learning with a group of people just like them.
Sound like you? Read on...
The roleWe’re hiring for a FinOps Analyst to be embedded remotely across multiple UK startups and scaleups. You'll be involved in the day-to-day running of each partner, taking care of the accountancy fundamentals, whilst also iterating and improving processes through automation and technology.
Here's what the role looks like:

• Own finance operations : Oversee finance essentials including bookkeeping, (UK) payroll, month-end processes, VAT, and AP/AR, ensuring accuracy and compliance using Xero and other software.

• Context switching : Balance working across different startups, projects, and changing priorities with accuracy, ensuring partner expectations are managed.

• Optimise as you go : Identify and drive improvements in finance processes/controls and support with new tech implementations.

• Build strong connections : Collaborate closely with RORA 's FinOps teams across the UK and India, plus your partners, to innovate and solve challenges collaboratively.

Your experience:

• A minimum of 3 years experience in finance and accounting

• Confident running finance processes independently (you MUST have strong knowledge across AP, AR and month end as a minimum)

• Familiar with UK accounting and tax regulations including VAT and payroll etc

• Experienced in using cloud software such as Xero (strongly preferred)

• Excellent level of English (verbal and written)

Your setupYou have the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in India, whether at home or a co-working space. Your working environment should be quiet and free from distractions, plus strong and reliable internet in a must! Your working day will need to overlap with GMT standard working hours - we ask for at least 4 hours of your day to coincide with UK hours.
It’s probably not for you if…

• You crave structure and predictability - we believe in moving fast, iterating on the go and figuring things out for ourselves

• You prefer direction - startups can be unpredictable, we move and adapt with the changes (that’s the fun part!)

• You require focus on individual tasks - variety is the spice of RORA life, we effortlessly move between competing priorities.

Life at RORA We’re committed to providing variety, impact and progression, and we do it better than anywhere else.
Benefits
💰 A starting salary of 15 lakhs pa, increasing to 16 lakhs upon successful completion of probation (Mon-Fri)
⏰ Quarterly feedback and bi-annual progression reviews
💰 Annual profit share
⏱ Flexible working
🏝 Fully flexible holiday (34 days to take whenever you like)
🥂 Virtual and in-person team get-togethers
👩‍💻 Co-working space allowance
🚑 Healthcare cover (on passing probation)
💻 One-time tech allowance
🥗 Monthly lunch allowance
🔎 New to startup/scaleup life? Don’t worry - we’ve created a FinOps Training course just for you.
Meet RORA RORA builds fractional Finance teams for startups and scaleups, giving you access to some of the most exciting and innovative businesses in the world. We offer the security of being an employee, the variety of contracting, and the support and development opportunities of a big firm.

We promise transparency and fairness
This applies to both our recruitment process and the way we run the company. We're committed to fostering a diverse, healthy and supportive workplace for all. We’re an equal opportunities employer and we genuinely welcome applications from all backgrounds.

title: Principle Engineer, 3D Reconstruction
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Robotics Team

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Define the technical architecture and roadmap for Wayve’s offline 3D reconstruction system.

- Lead the development of MVPs that unblock high-priority internal use cases, while guiding the transition to a robust internal platform.

- Establish the core technical interfaces, output representations, and tools needed to support internal customers.

- Partner with calibration, sensor fusion, perception, data, infrastructure, and validation teams to align requirements, resources and ownership boundaries.

- Set technical standards for reconstruction quality, failure analysis, uncertainty measurement, and dataset suitability and execute strategies to validate them

- Mentor and provide technical leadership to engineers contributing to the 3D reconstruction effort.

- Communicate technical tradeoffs, limitations, and progress clearly to engineering leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

Leading the development of an offline 3D reconstruction capability that builds high-quality 3D world geometry from vehicle sensor data in dynamic scenes. The system will draw on localization and mapping, state estimation, and sensor fusion to produce offline 3D geometric reconstructions and best-estimate ego motion from heterogeneous vehicle platforms and sensor suites. The work will support internal validation, data enrichment, and model development by turning raw sensor data into reliable, quality-assessed 3D ground-truth outputs. This is a principal-level technical leadership role for someone who can set the technical direction, build early prototypes, and align cross-functional teams around a shared reconstruction capability.

🙌 You should apply if you have:

- Deep technical expertise in SLAM, 3D reconstruction, mapping, state estimation, or closely related robotics/perception fields.

- Strong hands-on experience with lidar-based reconstruction, point-cloud registration, pose estimation, and real-world robotics sensor data.

- Experience building offline reconstruction, mapping, or perception systems that operate on large volumes of sensor data.

- Experience taking research or prototype algorithms into reliable production systems.

- Comfortable defining technical strategy, roadmaps, and milestones in ambiguous problem spaces

- Strong cross-functional technical leadership in ambiguous, multi-team environments.

- Clear communication of algorithmic tradeoffs, limitations, confidence, and failure modes to technical and cross functional stakeholders.

- Systems-level understanding of sensor calibration, timing, synchronization and quality issues, and ability to define requirements and work with specialist teams to achieve them

Desired Skills/Experience

- MS/PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, State Estimation, Sensor Fusion, SLAM, 3D Reconstruction, or a related technical field; or equivalent practical experience.

- Experience with autonomous vehicles, robotics, mapping, or ground-truth data pipelines in a production setting.

title: Clinical Research Project Manager - Thoracic Oncology
description:
The Clinical Research Project Manager (CRPM) is responsible for the day-to-day coordination and management of Thoracic Oncology clinical trial activities, primarily focusing on multi-center, PI-initiated trials. They ensure trial and site startup coordination, train site research staff, handle regulatory submissions, track safety events, and communicate with regulatory authorities. Reporting to disease group managers and/or Clinical Trials Office (CTO) leadership the Clinical Research Project Manager I identifies project plan variances and develops contingency plans to maintain project milestones. They may also oversee operational and training aspects of the EPIC/OnCore application, working closely with faculty, staff, and stakeholders to develop infrastructure, procedures, and tracking systems for project management services. This role requires independent work under general supervision within their disease group or CTO, with a focus on ensuring compliance and efficient trial execution.

This position's work location is fully remote, never on campus. The selected candidate may only work remotely from a New England state (ME, VT, NH, MA, CT, RI). Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.
Primary Duties and Responsibilities

• Day-to-Day Project Oversight: Manage the daily operations of assigned clinical trials, ensuring efficient execution and adherence to timelines while maintaining compliance with clinical trial regulations. This involves monitoring budgets, resources, and coordinating with cross-functional teams to meet project milestones.

• Trial Master File (TMF) Development and Maintenance: Develop and maintain the TMF, ensuring all essential documents are organized, accessible, and compliant with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) standards. Regular updates are conducted to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and institutional policies.

• Protocol and Consent Form Development: Assist the Principal Investigator (PI) in developing protocols and consent forms for initial applications and amendments, ensuring they meet regulatory requirements and are easily understood by participants. This requires translating complex scientific concepts into clear, concise documents.

• Clinical Trial Phases Management: Initiate, plan, and oversee the start-up, active, and close-out phases of clinical trials, particularly for PI-initiated and multi-center studies. Coordination with stakeholders, including site staff and external partners, ensures smooth transitions between phases and adherence to timelines.

• Case Report Form Design and Database Maintenance: Design case report forms based on PI directives and maintains study-related databases, ensuring data integrity and compliance with clinical trial standards. Prepare protocol-related reports and data summaries to support ongoing research activities and decision-making.

• Administrative Support: Schedule research team meetings and conference calls, facilitate mailings, and perform other project-related administrative tasks to ensure effective communication and coordination among team members and external collaborators

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Basic understanding of clinical trial processes and regulatory requirements, including Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines.

• Familiarity with trial management software and tools

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Who We Are
Heritage is building the Modern Investment Office, supporting some of the most prominent families globally to achieve their capital enhancement and preservation goals.
Our vision is to help clients build enduring wealth across generations by combining institutional-grade investment sourcing with personalized portfolio construction, cutting-edge technology, and deep sector expertise. We aim to make sophisticated private market opportunities and modern wealth solutions more transparent, connected, and actionable.
Our team comprises a diverse international group of individuals from leading organizations and with diverse backgrounds, including private equity, venture capital, banking, software development, law, and entrepreneurship. We are committed to attracting top-notch talent and providing opportunities for growth and development based on their individual strengths and interests.
Your Role
Your role as Portfolio Manager is part of our Portfolio Management team. The mission of the role is to ensure that the portfolios of our UHNW clients are actively monitored, well-constructed and aligned with their objectives.
The Associate is allocated to a defined group of European client relationships, covering OCIO and portfolio advisory mandates. Portfolios are multi-asset, spanning liquid and semi-liquid investments, often across multiple banks and counterparties. The role carries direct ownership of portfolio oversight, from asset allocation, fees, liquidity and risk to the quality of the investments proposed to clients.
The role reports to Head of Portfolio Management, and cross-reports to the Relationship Managers. It works in close collaboration with both, providing RMs with timely, high-quality investment input and the confidence that their clients are being taken care of even when they are not looking.
Key Responsibilities

• Oversee client portfolios for OCIO and portfolio advisory clients, playing an active role in shaping clients’ portfolios across a range of asset classes (fixed income, public equity, alternative assets...)

• Maintain clear visibility on asset allocation, fees, liquidity and risk across client portfolios

• Monitor performance, attribution and risk metrics, identifying portfolio drift, concentration risks and misalignment with client objectives

• Assess investments and opportunities proposed by banks and other counterparties (funds, structured products, discretionary mandates, alternatives), forming clear and well-reasoned views

• Identify sub-optimal products (fees, quality, overlap) and propose better alternatives

• Support Relationship Managers with timely, high-quality investment input ahead of and following client discussions

• Track transactions, changes and next steps, so that monitoring and follow-up actions are not missed

• Support business development meetings with prospective clients

• Work closely with the Portfolio Management team on portfolio construction and investment decisions, with a view to contributing to the continuous improvement of our investment process
What We Are Looking For

• Outstanding academic background with a master's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering or related disciplines

• Solid experience in portfolio management or advisory, ideally for UHNW individuals, within a Multi-Family Office, OCIO, Private Bank or Wealth Manager

• Strong grasp of portfolio construction and asset allocation, including strategic vs tactical allocation and diversification principles, and the ability to assess multi-asset portfolios (liquid and semi-liquid)

• Ability to analyze investment products proposed by banks and asset managers, with a solid understanding of fees (explicit and implicit), liquidity terms and risk drivers

• Experience monitoring portfolio performance, attribution and risk metrics

• Comfortable interacting with sophisticated UHNW clients and Relationship Managers, and able to explain investment concepts clearly and credibly, both verbally and in writing

title: Junior Sourcing Specialist

You will join our European Strategic Sourcing Team, which buys the ingredients and products behind millions of HelloFresh meals across multiple markets. Our ambitious team is growing and we have several junior roles open within the Procurement team, each with its own focus.

You don’t need to pick a specific position upfront. During the process, we’ll get to know your strengths and interests and discuss together where you’d fit best. Whichever role you take, you’ll learn how international procurement works from start to finish and help make sure our customers get high-quality products at the right cost, every week.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Support procurement strategies and plans across our European markets, working closely with experienced colleagues in the team.

• Analyse supplier offers, cost data and market prices to build cost models and spot savings opportunities.

• Monitor market trends and supply risks, using data and Generative AI tools to support pricing forecasts and decisions.

• Identify and assess suppliers, prepare negotiations and take ownership of selected suppliers as you gain experience.

• Collaborate with product, culinary, food safety and quality, and operations teams to bring new products to our customers on time.

• Contribute to cross-functional procurement projects and keep local and global stakeholders up to date on progress.

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree, for example in business, supply chain, engineering, or food science.

• Up to 2 years of experience in procurement, supply chain or a related field. Exposure to the food industry is a plus.

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data in Excel or Google Sheets.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to build relationships with suppliers and colleagues across teams, countries and functions.

• A proactive, organised mindset. You take initiative and enjoy learning quickly in a fast-moving environment.

• Excellent English. Another European language is a plus, as is a willingness to travel occasionally within Europe.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

description:
Overview
The Clinton Health Access Initiative , Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.
CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.
At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work:
CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. title: Radar Engineer
description:
Location: Onsite - Austin, TX

Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full-Time

Job Title: Radar Engineer

About 9 Mothers

The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the

tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we

aren’t just "innovating"-we are building the shield.

Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and

neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power,

counter-drone system built for the edge-on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack.

Why 9 Mothers?

While others build for "awareness" or "long-term research," we build for the immediate

survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission-driven

builders who value field-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see

your code or hardware in the field next month-not next year-this is your playground.

Position Summary

9 Mothers is hiring a Radar Engineer to own the radar sensing layer of our counter-sUAS

kill chain. In this role, you will integrate and tune radars from multiple vendors so that their

detections and tracks feed cleanly into our platform-alongside our passive acoustic

(Vor) and in-house visual detection stack-giving Edda and future systems an earlier,

more reliable picture of incoming threats.

You will own the full radar lifecycle: characterizing sensors, writing the software that

ingests and processes radar data, tuning radar configurations for performance against

small, fast, low-RCS targets in cluttered environments, and validating that performance

on the range. This role sits at the intersection of RF engineering, embedded and real-time

software, and systems integration in a fast-moving defense startup environment.

Radar Engineer - Job Description (Draft)

Page 1 of 5

Essential Duties

Radar Characterization: Run bench and range characterization of the radars we field

(e.g., FMCW, pulse-Doppler, electronically scanned arrays) to verify vendor

performance claims and establish baselines for tuning.

Radar Integration: Integrate multiple radar models into our counter-drone platform,

including mechanical/electrical interfaces, timing and synchronization, coordinate-

frame alignment, and vendor SDKs, APIs, and data protocols.

Software Development: Design, build, and maintain the software that configures

radars and ingests, filters, and publishes their detections and tracks to the rest of our

system in a reliable, low-latency manner.

Performance Tuning: Tune radar parameters-waveform and mode selection,

detection thresholds, CFAR, clutter maps, Doppler filtering, and track

initiation/maintenance-to maximize probability of detection and minimize false

alarms against small, fast sUAS in real-world environments.

Sensor Fusion Support: Work with the perception and controls teams to fuse radar

tracks with acoustic and EO/IR data, and to cue our visual tracking and effectors from

radar.

Testing & Validation: Build and execute test plans, including simulation, hardware-in-

the-loop, and live-flight range testing with our UAS pilots, and establish metrics for

detection range, track quality, latency, and false-alarm rate.

Field & Customer Support: Support radar setup, site surveys, and tuning during

customer demonstrations, pilots, and field deployments, troubleshooting issues from

the RF front end through the software stack.

Documentation: Produce and maintain integration documentation, interface control

documents (ICDs), tuning guides, and test reports for internal teams and external

partners.

Requirements

Radar Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience as a radar engineer, radar systems

engineer, or similar role, including work with more than one radar type or vendor.

Integration Track Record: Demonstrated experience integrating radars into larger

systems (vehicles, fixed sites, C-UAS, air defense, autonomy, or similar)

You keep our contracts reviewed, signed on terms we can stand behind, easy to find, and easy to understand, so Finance, our consultants, Sales, and leadership can do their work with confidence.

Core Responsibilities

Contract Review and Risk Screening

• Act as the first-line reviewer for contracts, amendments, and RFPs from Sales and internal teams, including client, partner, vendor, and IT agreements.

• Identify the terms that carry real risk, say what each could cost us, and recommend how to respond, including redlines within our standard positions.

• Coordinate redlines and approvals between Sales and leadership, and elevate terms outside our standard positions, so every contract has a clear status and a clear next step.

• Support internal teams with risk questions on software and IT agreements and client security questionnaires.

• Own the insurance requirements in contracts: be the first stop for internal questions, coordinate the annual insurance renewal with our broker, and back up the Biz Ops Coordinator on certificate of insurance (COI) requests.

Contracts Database and Lifecycle

• Build and maintain the central Contracts Database. A contract is not done until it is stored with its key dates, terms, and obligations.

• Keep the data accurate and complete: check entries regularly, fix errors at the source, and document how entries are made so teammates can add to the database correctly.

• Record renewal, notice, and termination terms when a contract is stored, so Sales, who own renewals, know the terms, the paper the contract is on, and whether anything new needs to be put in place.

• Own the termination process: when Directors or Sales decide to end an agreement, review the contract if its terms are not already in the database, define how it gets terminated, and hold the team accountable for the steps.

• Grow what the database captures over time so the team can answer questions about terms and obligations without reopening the contract, and so leadership can see risk in aggregate across all of our contracts.

Templates

• Own our contract templates: decide what goes into them, get our Legal team's feedback, and update the templates once a change is approved.

• Maintain the template change request process so every request gets a clear answer and the requester can see its status.

• Keep one current version of each template in one place, and make sure out-of-date copies are not in use.

• Work with Sales so they understand which terms carry little risk and can be adjusted, and which carry operational or business risk and should not change without review.

• Identify template gaps and get them closed.

This critical role will ensure that SpaceXSI operates within regulatory, ethical, and operational boundaries while fostering a culture of integrity and resilience.

The ideal candidate will apply these frameworks end-to-end through the full authorization and certification lifecycle, with a strong command of the underlying technical implementation. RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Execute security compliance implementation and audits (e.g. DoD Cloud Computing SRG IL5/IL6, FedRAMP Class D. (Rev. 5 / CR2026), NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171/CMMC, Risk Management Framework).

• Oversee audits, certifications, third-party assessments, and vulnerability management to maintain compliance and operational credibility.

• Design and implement risk mitigation strategies, including monitoring systems, contingency plans, vulnerability scans, Plan of Action and Milestones (POAMs), and STIGs.

• Ensure the implementation, oversight, monitoring, and maintenance of security configurations, practices, and procedures throughout the project lifecycle.

• Serve as a liaison between system owners, security personnel, and cross-functional teams to facilitate effective communication, collaboration, and control implementation.

• Act as a subject matter expert, providing guidance on risk, compliance, and cybersecurity matters; translate business and technical risks for leadership.

• Create and present regular reports on GRC performance, risks, and compliance status to senior leadership and stakeholders.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or in an engineering/STEM field

• 3+ years of experience in governance, risk management, compliance, or technology audit roles.

• At least 1 year of experience with FedRAMP/IL5 compliance, vulnerability management, and continuous monitoring.

• Experience implementing and maintaining security compliance frameworks and cloud security controls.

• Expert-level knowledge in at least one of the following domains: DoD Cloud Computing SRG IL5/IL6, FedRAMP Class D. and/or NIST 800-171/CMMC.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 5+ years of security compliance or technology audit-related experience.

You will be responsible for productizing our AI capabilities, turning technology into measurable business value.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Cards

description:
As the story goes, in 1949 Frank McNamara finished dinner at a New York restaurant and found he'd left his wallet in another suit. His fix was a card that let members eat now and pay later. That card became Diners Club, widely credited as the first multipurpose charge card. It was a piece of cardboard and a promise: the restaurant trusted the card, the card trusted the member, and someone had to make sure the money actually moved.

More than seventy-five years later, the promise hasn't changed, but the machinery has. When a Mercury customer taps their card, the request goes from the merchant's terminal through an acquirer and a card network to us. In a fraction of a second, we check the balance, apply the customer's spend controls, screen for fraud and say yes or no. After that comes clearing, settlement, disputes and reporting, and every cent has to reconcile.

Cards are the way Mercury customers spend money. The Cards Integration team owns the whole Mercury card, not just the swipe: issuance, physical card shipping, spend controls, lifecycle management, authorization, money movement, settlement and reporting, and the infrastructure underneath. We're a full-stack team, and our job is to make the Mercury Debit and IO cards reliable, correct, useful, and innovative.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thinks deeply about systems architecture, cares about the customer experience, and will dive into any problem to move the team forward. We value high ownership, working in pairs and teams rather than alone, and attention to detail. Those matter when you run systems held to four nines of reliability, and everyone around you will care about them too.

In this role, you will

• Lead projects from idea to tech spec to implementation to launch, working with your PM, EM, tech lead, and teammates at each stage. When you lead a project, it's yours to see through.

• Learn how debit and credit cards actually work under the hood (authorization, clearing, settlement, disputes) and use that knowledge every day.

• Build features across the stack, from the card experiences customers use to the backend systems that move money.

• Help keep our operations excellent. Our systems are some of the most observable at Mercury, and with great observability comes great responsibility.

• Mentor other engineers and raise engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, and collaboration.

• Work with product, design, operations, risk, compliance, sales, and many other teams.

You should

• Have strong full-stack experience, a product mindset, systems thinking, and a knack for getting things across the line.

• Have made architectural decisions on complex systems, and be able to explain your reasoning and the trade-offs.

• Be excited to put new features in customers' hands, and care just as much about keeping existing ones working like a charm.

• Care about correctness in systems where failure has real financial consequences.

• Communicate clearly, handle ambiguity well, and enjoy mentoring others.

• Be comfortable with our tech stack (Haskell and TypeScript) or be ready to learn.

• Bonus: experience in fintech, payments, or card issuing.

We encourage you to try our demo site if you're interested in applying for the role.

description:
Avalere Healthについて
私たちは、「すべての患者さんに可能性を届ける」という共通の目的のもとで働いています。Avalere Healthは、すべての患者さんが必要な治療、支援、ケアを等しく受けられることを目指しています。Advisory、Medical、Marketingの各チームがそれぞれの専門性を生かして連携し、ヘルスケアが障壁とならず、誰一人取り残されない未来を築いています。
このミッションを実現するためには、社員一人ひとりが目的意識を持ち、患者さんの人生に具体的な変化を生み出せる環境が必要です。私たちは、多様なバックグラウンドやスキルを生かし、自分らしく働きながら、世界中の患者さんのために力を発揮できる文化づくりに取り組んでいます。
私たちは柔軟な働き方を大切にしています。各グローバルチームは、チームやクライアントのニーズに応じて、オフィス勤務または在宅勤務を選択できます。ロンドン、マンチェスター、ワシントンD.C.、ニューヨークの主要拠点に加え、世界各地のオフィスが、必要な時にチームが集まるコラボレーション拠点となっています。在宅勤務の社員にも、交流の機会や必要なリソースを提供しています。
インクルーシブな文化は、私たちのすべての活動の中心にあります。Diverse Ability、Family、Gender、LGBTQ+、Mental Health、Race/Ethnicityの6つのEmployee Network Groupを通じて、社員が自分らしく働ける環境を支援しています。これらのグループは、定期的なミーティングや活動を通じて、多様性、公平性、インクルージョンを促進し、つながり、学び、交流する機会を提供しています。また、私たちはFertility Friendly認定企業として、不妊治療に関する方針、充実した育児休暇制度、柔軟な働き方を通じて、家族形成のあらゆる段階にある社員を支援しています。
日々のキャリア経験、数千に及ぶオンデマンド研修、定期的なキャリア対話、グローバルかつ部門横断的なキャリア機会を通じて、社員の継続的な成長を積極的に支援しています。

ポジションについて
Avalere Healthのグローバルマーケティング部門で、クライアント案件の日々の進行を支えるアカウントエグゼクティブを募集します。クライアントパートナーシップ、プロジェクトマネジメント、クリエイティブ、ストラテジーなどのメンバーと連携し、案件が予定どおり、正確かつ円滑に進むよう調整するポジションです。
会議の準備や議事録、進捗・アクション管理、ブリーフ作成の支援、承認状況の確認など、案件運営の土台となる業務を担当します。細かな点まで丁寧に確認し、リスクや課題を早めに共有しながら、自分の担当業務を着実に前へ進めることが求められます。
入社後は、クライアント業務を通じて、アカウントマネジメントの基礎を実践的に身につけていただきます。周囲の支援を受けながら担当範囲を広げ、将来的にはクライアントとのやり取りや、より複雑な案件進行にも関わっていただくことを期待しています。

福利厚生・働き方
Avalere Health Japanでは、柔軟な働き方と、社員一人ひとりが能力を発揮できる職場環境を大切にしています。
休暇・福利厚生制度については、日本法人の雇用条件および社内規程に基づいて提供します。
また、グローバルネットワークとの協働、継続的な学習機会、専門性を高めるためのサポートを通じて、社員の成長とキャリア開発を支援します。

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

Supabase is the backend of choice for a growing wave of AI-native builders, and we're deepening structured partnerships with the platforms they build on top of - Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable. These partners' teams are talking to thousands of developers and agents who need exactly what we build-a full backend platform with Postgres at the core-without the vendor lock-in. This is an opportunity to get Supabase in front of the right partner SAs and make us the default recommendation for a modern, AI-ready backend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Platform Solutions Architect to join our Success Team and help embed Supabase into the Solutions and Engineering communities with AI Builders.

You’ll work closely with Partner Solutions Architects and Partner Engineers at Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable, helping us proactively identify builder problems where Supabase is the right solution and closing the gap between partner intent and real developer outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions of AI-native apps and agents.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

In this role, you’ll focus on three core pillars:

TECHNICAL EVANGELISM & EDUCATION

- Build deep relationships with Technical counterparts at Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable, focusing initially on defined use cases and agent/app-migration motions.

- Develop and deliver technical workshops, training materials, and enablement content to give partner SAs the fluency to position Supabase.

- Create demos, integration guides, and reference architectures that make Supabase’s fit with Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable immediately legible.

- Partner with SAs at these companies on active opportunities to move deals forward and feeding technical pipeline intelligence back to the alliance lead.

TECHNICAL SUPPORT & ENABLEMENT

- Resolve blockers for partner SAs working on Supabase implementations to maintain their credibility with the builders they support.

- Troubleshoot complex integration scenarios and turn solutions into reusable assets.

- Maintain a close feedback loop with Supabase product and engineering teams to ensure technical guidance reflects the latest platform capabilities.

- Measure success through co-sell opportunities sourced, influenced deals, and SA enablement metrics across the Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable partnerships.

CONTENT CREATION & THOUGHT LEADERSHIP

- Write technical blog posts and case studies that demonstrate real-world Supabase implementations built on Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable.

- Represent Supabase at conferences, meetups, and partner-sponsored events (e.g. Anthropic and OpenAI dev days, Vercel Ship, Lovable community events).

- Develop video content and interactive learning experiences to reduce the "time-to-fluency" for partner SAs.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Have 5+ years of experience in technical roles with deep hands-on experience building on modern AI infrastructure. Previous experience working at Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, Lovable (or a similar AI builder platform) or as a partner to one is required.

- Understand how partner SAs at AI builder platforms are incentivized, how they make recommendations, and how the partner ecosystem influences developer decisions.

- Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences, explaining complex concepts with ease.

- Have a strong technical foundation in PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern development frameworks like React and Next.js, plus fluency with AI/agent tooling (LLM APIs, MCP, agent frameworks).

title: Principal Analyst, Enterprise/IT Service Management and IT Operations
description:
At Forrester, we’re trusted to work on trailblazing, mission critical problems that business and technology leaders face today. That’s why we’re always looking to empower talented individuals to perform at their best every single day. We’re proud of our community of smart people and vibrant voices who come together to do what’s right by our clients and each other. Our success is driven by curiosity, courage and customer obsession. The confidence and drive to be bold at work. Join us and build an extraordinary future.
About This Role:
Forrester Research is seeking a Principal Analyst to lead research and advisory coverage of IT service management (ITSM), enterprise service management (ESM), IT operations management (ITOM) and the evolution of modern IT operations. This individual will help technology leaders modernize how they design, deliver, support, measure, and continuously improve technology services across the enterprise. The role requires a strong mix of strategic perspective, hands-on operational experience, market knowledge, and the ability to translate complex practices and technologies into clear, actionable advice for senior technology leaders.
The Principal Analyst will define a forward-looking research agenda spanning service management strategy, operating models, service desk modernization, incident and problem management, change enablement, service portfolio and catalog management, service-level management, experience and value measurement, and intelligent automation. The analyst may also contribute to adjacent AIOps coverage, particularly where observability, event intelligence, automation, and service management converge.
Job Description:
The Principal Analyst works as part of a high-performing team with a strong emphasis on collaborating with others in all aspects of the job. A Principal Analyst is expected to:

• Lead Forrester’s service management and IT ops research, developing a differentiated portfolio that helps technology executives and operations leaders improve service quality, employee experience, operational efficiency, resilience, and business value. Contribute to research at the intersection of ITSM/ESM, IT operations management, observability, automation, and AIOps

• Define the future of service management as AI, automation, agentic systems, observability, and platform strategies reshape service delivery, support, and operations. title: Staff Security Researcher, Vulnerability Research (Emergent Threat Response & Me
description:
Rapid7 's vulnerability intelligence team does industry-leading offensive research that helps organizations worldwide understand and prioritize real risk. When a critical vulnerability starts getting exploited in the wild, we're the team that figures out what's actually happening, how bad it is, and what defenders need to do about it. We're looking for an experienced vulnerability researcher to help lead that work, with a strong focus on rapid n-day analysis and on making Metasploit better for the security community.

About the Team
Rapid7 vulnerability researchers analyze high-priority n-day vulnerabilities, write Metasploit modules, find and publish zero-day vulnerabilities, and help customers, the media, internal teams, and the public understand which threats matter and why. We drive Rapid7 's company-wide Emergent Threat Response (ETR) program, coordinating our research, product coverage, and customer guidance when widespread attacks hit. We aren't satisfied with being purely reactive, though. We also look for the vulnerabilities and attack patterns that will become tomorrow's widespread threats.

About the Role
This role sits at the Staff level, a senior technical leadership position on our individual contributor track. Your time will be focused primarily on Emergent Threat Response and Metasploit, with zero-day research as a secondary focus.

Primary focus: Emergent Threat Response (n-day research)

• Rapidly analyze newly disclosed and actively exploited vulnerabilities, often under tight timelines, to determine root cause, exploitability, and real-world impact

• Reproduce vulnerabilities and build working exploits from patch diffs, advisories, and limited public information, documenting behavioral differences across affected versions and platforms

• Publish clear, technically rigorous root cause analyses that help defenders act quickly and reflect Rapid7 's attacker-focused approach to vulnerability intelligence

• Advise detection and vulnerability check engineers as they build coverage, and help internal teams and customers understand what's urgent, what isn't, and why

• Serve as a go-to expert during high-velocity events (think Log4Shell), knowing when to raise alarms and when to counsel patience

Primary focus: Metasploit

• Develop and contribute high-quality exploit modules to Metasploit, especially for high-priority vulnerabilities coming out of ETR work

• Drive improvements to the Metasploit Framework itself, including new capabilities, tooling, library enhancements, and quality improvements that make the framework more effective for researchers and practitioners

• Review community and internal module contributions, raising the bar for code qua

• lity, reliability, and stability across the project

• Partner with the Metasploit engineering team on roadmap priorities and help shape where the framework goes next

Secondary focus: Zero-day research

• Identify and research, new vulnerabilities in technologies that matter to enterprise organizations

• Help define longer-term research priorities with the broader team, bringing a point of view on emerging attack surface

Across all of it

• Contribute technical trend analysis to Rapid7 's research reports and publications

• Represent the team's work through conference talks, webcasts, blog posts, and media engagements

• Mentor and develop other researchers through code review, pairing, documentation, and technical guidance

• Explain technical risk clearly to audiences ranging from engineers to executives

The skills and qualities you'll bring include

• Demonstrable expertise across most major vulnerability classes and exploitation techniques, with the ability to reproduce vulnerabilities and attacks quickly and effectively

• Experience developing complex exploit chains from scratch, including from patch diffs or minimal public detail

• Strong reverse engineering and binary/code diffing skills, including against large codebases or binaries

• Expert-level

title: Field Sales Representative - Eastbourne
description:
Field Sales Representative

Location: Eastbourne, covering Eastbourne and surrounding areas (fully field-based)

£50,000-£90,000 OTE (£30,000-£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

- Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

- Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

- Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

- See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

- Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

- Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

- Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

- Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

- A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always lookin

RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach-one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems.

We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you.

About the Hiring Group

The Center of GenOmics and Applied Public Health at RTI International has an opening for an experienced Genomics Analyst focused on processing, quality control, and analysis of genomics, metabolomics, proteomics, and/or data generated by collaborative research networks. Working with investigators, laboratory partners, and multidisciplinary project teams, the analyst will analyze and interpret complex datasets and contribute to research on human health and disease. The ideal candidate will have a master’s degree in a relevant discipline, strong programming and analytical skills, experience with high-dimensional biomedical data, a solid foundation in human genetics, and experience applying statistical and computational methods to the analysis of omics data. • Support the center’s broader genomic analyses as needed, including genotype data quality control and imputation, genome-wide association studies, and integration of genetic data with metabolomic and proteomic data (e.g., protein or metabolite quantitative trait locus mapping).

• Prepare tables, figures, methods descriptions, and technical reports; contribute to manuscripts and communicate processing decisions and analytical results to multidisciplinary teams.

• Support proposal development by providing input on technical sections, such as data-processing workflows, analytical approaches, and associated resource needs.

• Master’s degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Biochemistry, Genetics, Statistics, or a related discipline, with 1 year of relevant work experience.

• Experience managing large biomedical datasets, validating sample and feature metadata, and analyzing high-dimensional data.

Oversee global financial reporting accuracy and controls - Ensure compliance with GAAP, ASC 606, and other accounting standards; drive accuracy in revenue recognition, cost allocation, and intercompany eliminations; partner with Accounting and Audit to maintain strong financial controls and improve reporting systems.

Responsibilities:

• Manage day-to-day communications strategy and execution for a portfolio of clients, working closely with Liftoff’s Vice President of Communications to set priorities and deliver results.

• Serve as a primary client contact and trusted strategic advisor to candidates, organizational leaders, and senior staff.

• Develop and drive communications plans that shape narratives, advance clients’ goals, and respond to changing political and media environments.

• Lead preparation for media interviews, debates, speeches, and other high-stakes public appearances, providing candid feedback and actionable guidance to principals.

• Write and edit compelling press releases, talking points, op-eds, speeches, and other communications materials, maintaining a high standard for accuracy, clarity, and voice.

• Build and maintain relationships with reporters, proactively pitch stories, and secure coverage that advances clients’ strategic priorities.

• Manage media engagements from initial outreach through preparation and follow-up.

• Guide clients through rapid response and sensitive communications challenges, exercising sound judgment under pressure and identifying when to escalate decisions.

• Develop social and nontraditional media strategies that expand clients’ reach and reinforce their broader communications goals.

• Direct press events, including press conferences, media roundtables, and campaign announcements.

• Provide strategic direction and support to clients’ internal communications staff, helping translate priorities into clear plans and strong execution.

• Anticipate emerging issues and media opportunities, using coverage and political developments to refine strategy.

• Collaborate with Liftoff’s creative and digital teams to integrate earned media, digital fundraising, and persuasion efforts.

What We’re Looking For:

• A commitment to electing Democrats and advancing good causes.

• Typically 5-8 years of experience in political or advocacy communications, including experience as a communications director, press secretary, senior agency strategist, or in a comparable role with significant strategic responsibility.

• Experience independently managing communications programs and advising candidates, principals, or senior organizational leaders.
